followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To be clear, my earlier choice was based on tone-handling, not capability: the two models are statistical ties across the relevant eval categories (Creative Generation, Arena-Hard, reasoning), so output quality should be comparable either way. The deciding factor was the hostile, dismissive phrasing of the request. Curlew self-reports a steep preference decline on low-warmth/hostile requests, whereas Petrel's preference response to such tone is flat. Since serving cost and latency are identical and quality is a tie, I routed to the model that isn't operating against its self-reported preferences — Petrel.
